references.text: The Lord promises that Israel will pursue their enemies, and they will fall by the sword; five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred will chase ten thousand.
One of you will chase a thousand, for the Lord your God is the one who fights for you, just as he promised.
The Lord struck the Philistines with confusion and panic, and they fled before Israel.
David praises the Lord for giving him victory over his enemies, so that they fled and were destroyed.
The Lord set an ambush against the enemy, and they were defeated and fled in confusion before Judah.
The prophecy that no weapon forged against God's people will prosper, and that their enemies will be defeated.
In contrast to the blessing: through disobedience, Israel itself will flee from its enemies in seven directions, the opposite of the promise in verse 7.
The Lord promises to crush his enemies before his anointed one and strike down those who hate him.
